ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with an approximate ratio of 1.2:1 (white-to-black pixels) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity (black) region extending from peduncle to median notch; two high-intensity (white) regions occupying the central lobes; black borders along leading and trailing edges; high-density black mottling and linear clusters concentrated on the left lobe's white surface and the inner right lobe's white surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 38 degrees and a narrow vertex depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; distinct deep notch indentation on the inner left lobe; varying pixel amplitude with sharper peaks toward the outer tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature sweeping upwards into narrow, acute-angled distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity circular pixel clusters representing dense barnacle colonization on the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned vertical and diagonal linear disruptions present in the white region of the left lobe; fewer, faint linear marks visible in the white region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on distal tips; significant irregular notch-like trauma on the trailing edge of the inner left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: One prominent dark circular spot situated within the white region of the left lobe near the lower black border interface; cluster of dark marks resembling alphanumeric characters on the mid-right lobe.
